free_text.inst.v2.D8: The opening paragraph is generic enough to fit almost any confident public speaker - 'quick-minded and talkative, at home with words, numbers and dealing' - true of me, true of half of any parliament. Where it actually collides with the record is in two places. First, it puts 'illness, debts and rivals' in both the 'reads well' bucket and the 'live right now' list, which means it is telling me my rivals are going WELL for me right now. That is backwards: the caucus revolt through late 2024 and my resignation announcement in January 2025 was rivals working spectacularly against me, not for me. Second, and worse, the 'Right now' section states flatly that 'the method reads an ordinary stretch.' There was nothing ordinary about the eighteen months before a reading like this would have been cast - my marriage of eighteen years ended in August 2023, and the internal party pressure that followed is what drove me out of office in early 2025. Calling that stretch ordinary misses the two biggest events of my adult life landing back to back. Where it does land something real, maybe by coincidence, is the 'home, property and your mother' bucket marked 'mixed' - that is an honest one-word summary of my relationship with my mother, whose bipolar disorder and the public unraveling of my parents' marriage in the 1970s gave way, eventually, to real closeness. The 'unusually positive about your health and energy' line, repeated three times in a row like a stuck record, is at least consistent with the boxing and the years as an outdoor instructor, but it reads like a glitch, not an insight. Overall: partly right, mostly by accident, and wrong exactly where it mattered most - calling my hardest stretch an ordinary one.
